name: ATMOSPHERE OS — ACCOUNT PAYMENT DETAILS
changes: Adds persistent bank-transfer payment details inside the authenticated customer account
Shows a clear pending-confirmation explanation before manager approval
After approval, securely returns recipient, IBAN, amount and payment purpose only to the owner of the order
Adds one-tap copy actions for all requisites or IBAN only
Hides payment requisites after payment, refund or cancellation
Preserves v16.0.3 checkout promos, thank-you layout and all previous payment flows
notes: The account-payment-details Edge Function is deployed with JWT verification enabled.
PAYMENT_IBAN and PAYMENT_RECIPIENT remain Supabase Secrets and are not embedded in public storefront files.
Bank requisites become available when a bank-transfer order moves beyond the initial new status.
